messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: runtime v3.0.0 -> serving-pool A (canary 3 hosts). Pinlist PR: #2042. sdk_min: 1.6.0. models: llama4q -> quantized-v2. ETA: 10m.

tyler: saw this, thanks. quick heads-up — canary logs show repeated OOM on kv-cache allocation for llama4q on 2/3 hosts. stack traces attached to the CI artifact.

leah: confirmed. repro script fails in our perf harness: quantized kernels in 3.0.0 are hitting a codepath that assumes 64-bit offsets. might be a mismatch with the new SDK serialization header.

maria: is this a runtime-only issue or an sdk/runtime compatibility problem? can we fallback to previous runtime safely?

sam: SDK 1.6.0 introduced the new IO header (field names+version). runtime 2.9.x doesn't understand it, so simply downgrading runtime without changing SDK could break callers. we need one of: backport header parsing to 2.9.x, pin SDK to 1.5.x, or keep runtime and patch kernel.

oliver: telemetry during the canary shows increased decode errors (0.8% -> 2.4%) and a small uptick in latency p95. Not massive but correlated with canary traffic.

tyler: given the OOMs and decode bump, my vote is to pause the rollout and revert the pinlist to the previous known-good combo: runtime 2.9.1 + sdk 1.5.6. We can then triage kernel fix in 3.0.0 branch.

maria: +1 to pause. We should also add an emergency compatibility test that runs serialization+kv-cache stress for quantized models before any future pin.

leah: agreed. I'll draft the test and add to canary gating. It will run the serialization roundtrip and a short kv-cache stress.

sam: I'll prepare a short-lived SDK patch (1.6.1) that falls back to the old header for 2.x runtimes; that buys time if we need to support new SDK features. But prefer pin SDK back to 1.5.6 for immediate safety.

tyler: operational decision: pause rollout, revert pinlist, trigger rollback deploy job. @oncall-bot please watch runtime-serving for errors over next 30m.

oncall-bot: Rollback deploy job queued: rollback-runtime-1799 -> runtime 2.9.1. ETA 6m. Monitors: runtime-errors, kv-cache-OOM, decode-errors. Link: https://deploy.company/reverts/1799

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by tyler. Rollback ID: rb-1799-202. Targets: pool A canary hosts -> 2.9.1.

oliver: monitoring: first host reverted, error rate trending down to baseline.

maria: filing a short postmortem ticket and adding compatibility checklist to release playbook. PR for tests: #2045.

tyler: thanks all. action items: (1) sam to open SDK quick-fix or pin PR (2) leah to add gating test (#2045) (3) infra to hold v3.0.0 pin until green canary and compat tests.

sam: opened PR #2043 to pin SDK -> 1.5.6 for the deployment window. If CI passes we'll merge in 5m.

leah: adding test harness now, will link when ready.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete on all canary hosts. Monitors green. Closing rollout for v3.0.0 until further notice.

tyler: closing thread — we'll reschedule the v3.0.0 rollout after fix + canary gating. :thumbsup:
